title: Diff-bound evidence reuse policy
rawUserRequest: Implement WI-09 of the approved 14-WI AI Cockpit improvement plan: add a repository-local, deterministic diff-bound evidence reuse policy on top of the WI-07 binding foundation. Bind exact base/head commits, normalized changed-path identity, security scope, and governance policy; fail closed to rerun for unknown, malformed, stale, or mismatched inputs; preserve all required verification and gate authority. Execute in English low-token mode with a dedicated branch, PR, archive, merge, closure lifecycle, and no new Work Item for in-scope defects.

declaredIntent.summary: Provide a narrow diff-bound policy that can identify an exactly matching changed-path evidence binding without permitting skipped checks or governance bypass.

outOfScope: Implementing WI-08 content-bound or WI-10 environment-bound reuse policies.
Changing the WI-07 evidence-binding schema or foundation API.
Changing ai_verify, verification context, required-check execution, cache, scheduler, retry, provider, CI, or network behavior.
Granting permission to skip security, scope, governance, coverage, or required-check gates, or inferring reuse from timestamps, branch names, or agent self-report.

sources.reason: WI-07 foundation API and fail-closed binding identity to consume without changing.
Existing classification, digest, immutability, and Unknown-to-rerun conventions.
Documented handoff boundary and exact-match semantics for WI-08/09/10.
Repository-local changed-path and verification input vocabulary; no runtime integration is permitted.
Existing source-backed requirements for exact source revision and normalized changed-path identity.

riskAssessment.reason: An incorrectly accepted diff binding could reuse evidence after the source revision, changed paths, security scope, or governance policy changed.

reasons: The diff-bound policy is a governance-facing evidence decision API and requires strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The policy is bounded to exact diff identity and deterministic local decisions; execution authority remains with existing verification gates.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A pure Python policy API consumes a valid WI-07 diff-bound binding plus current base commit, head commit, normalized changed paths, security scope digest, and governance policy digest, and returns a deterministic structured decision.

Reuse is eligible only when baseCommit, headCommit, changedPathsDigest, security scope, governance policy, and binding freshness match exactly; changed paths are canonicalized as a sorted unique repository-relative set before digesting.

Missing, malformed, unknown, stale, cross-scope, cross-governance, commit-mismatched, or changed-path-mismatched inputs return state=unknown or state=stale with action=rerun and stable reason codes; no result grants authority to skip a required check.

Focused tests cover exact reuse, base/head mismatch, added/removed/renamed path changes, path normalization and duplicate rejection, scope/governance mismatch, unknown/malformed/expired bindings, deterministic output, and caller-input immutability.

A reference document records the policy input contract, changed-path canonicalization, fail-closed semantics, API boundary, and explicit non-integration handoff to WI-08/WI-10; no scheduler, cache, verifier, or gate integration is introduced.
guidelines: Compare exact canonical repository-relative changed-path identity and source revision; never infer equivalence from branch names or timestamps.
Fail closed to rerun for Unknown, malformed, stale, mismatched, cross-scope, or cross-governance evidence.
Keep the policy pure and local; existing verification runners retain authority to execute every required check.

intent.problem: WI-07 provides a generic diff-bound binding, but without a policy-specific changed-path identity check a later caller could treat a receipt from another base/head or path set as reusable.
constraints: Use the WI-07 foundation as-is and keep this Work Item limited to diff-bound policy behavior.
Unknown, malformed, expired, or mismatched evidence must require rerun and never be upgraded by inference.
Every decision must compare security scope and governance policy identity in addition to source revision and changed paths.
Do not alter required-check execution or add caching, scheduling, provider, or network behavior.
intent.rationale: A small policy-specific pure function makes changed-path reuse conditions explicit and testable while preserving the existing verification authority boundary.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A diff-bound binding has identical base/head commits, normalized changed paths, security scope, governance policy, and valid freshness.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The decision is deterministic state=fresh, action=reuse, with no reasons.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused test builds a diff binding and evaluates the same canonical current diff twice.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The current diff changes by commit, added/removed/renamed path, or path ordering/duplication.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The decision is state=stale or state=unknown, action=rerun, with stable reason codes and no reuse.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused tests cover each source and changed-path identity variation, including normalization and malformed paths.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Security scope or governance policy is missing, malformed, or different from the binding.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The decision fails closed to rerun and never becomes reusable.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused tests cover both mismatch and unknown cases and assert stable reason ordering.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
